END_IDENTITY: Signed independent observer receipt binding complete snapshot digest and exact same mutation_revision,registrytip,generation,session,context
SNAPSHOT_IDENTITY: Closed canonical codec complete19source146field projection digest
AUTHORITY_STATE_AFTER: Equal revision and verified complete snapshot bound to post-observation challenge, not digest equality alone
VALIDATION: All source identities/reader constraints/snapshot coherence/event coverage/current revision known true; any intervening relevant event invalidates
PUBLICATION_ORDER: Writer performs CAS(expected mutation_revision,registrytip,generation,snapshotID,workunconsumed) under same domain serialization as mutationBEGIN; append one-use qualification receipt only on exact match. MutationBEGIN before CAS invalidates; CAS before mutationBEGIN produces receipt immediately invalidated for futureuse. Consumers revalidate revision under same conditionaluse protocol, never trust old receipt alone.
INVALIDATION: Monotonic before mutation takes effect; no ABA rollback to earlier validrevision
CRASH: PersistpendingUNKNOWN and revision highwater; no truncate-to-success/reset
TIMEOUT: Versioned positive bounded observation lease; missing/overflow=>deny
RESTART: Retire old process/session/observer incarnation; newgeneration before newqualification
adapter_requirement: Future mediation proof must cover every mutation class and relevant source path before activation; prove begin-before-effect linearization and CAS order. Trusted HOST outside malicious-admin threat model, but governed admin mutations still routed; any unmediated relevant mutator means domainNOTCONFORMANT.
